home_subhead: I help companies build relationships with their audiences. I communicate their story, and keep the tone consistent everywhere it shows up. From the homepage and the product, to email and the founder's voice, I make complex, technical ideas easy to trust.
cases_intro: Brand voice is only as good as its range. Here are examples of my work across multiple industries and external channels: a case study created for Retool, an email campaign and founder story for an insurtech company, and a fabricator's product catalog.
work_intro: I write brand voice for companies with something complex to explain. My work spans marketing campaigns, product and web copy, and founder storytelling. At NYT Wirecutter it means turning technical product testing into clear, trustworthy copy read by millions. A selection of my work is below, with the full resume.
